en: The front of the postcard features black-and-white illustrated scenes identified as 'Brunnenplatz', 'Evang. Kirche', 'Schloss', 'Dunsthöhle', and 'Helenenquelle' from the spa town of Bad Pyrmont. Floral embellishments frame the illustrations, with handwritten script overlaying the lower section. The back shows a handwritten address and a 5 Pfennig German stamp postmarked 'Pyrmont'. There's also a blue stamp indicating 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont'.
